claim: The dataset contains 2,759 cells and 241 protein imaging features with annotated age, phase, state, and batch metadata.
The full-feature reference trajectory is biologically oriented: pseudotime Spearman correlation with annotated age = 0.141.
The top 20 dynamic features preserve the reference pseudotime with mean |Spearman| 0.793, compared with 0.665 for high-variance features and 0.707±0.055 for random panels.
Selected molecules show interpretable, smooth expression programs across trajectory bins.
